videos.title: What If You Dropped a Penny From the Empire State Building? 🪙
videos.description:
Without air it would hit at 177 mph. With air, a flat tumbling penny never beats about 25 mph. It stings, that's it.
Would you stand under it? 👇

penny empire state building, terminal velocity, air resistance, falling penny myth, physics simulation, what if
